title: The 4 Best Adjustable Dumbbells for Home Gyms
h1: The 4 Best Adjustable Dumbbells for Home Gyms
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for adjustable dumbbells for home gyms, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at adjustable dumbbells for home gyms using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Bowflex SelectTech 552 Adjustable Dumbbells (Pair)
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 to 52.5 lb per hand, 2.5 lb increments, Dial-turn selector, roughly 3-second changes, Molded storage trays included.
strengths: Fastest, most proven adjustment mechanism in the category
Consistent 2.5 lb increments across the full range for smooth progression
Widest parts and accessory availability of any adjustable dumbbell
limitations: 52.5 lb ceiling with no official expansion path
features: 5 to 52.5 lb per hand, 2.5 lb increments
Largest install base in the category

products.name: PowerBlock Elite EXP Stage 1 Adjustable Dumbbells, 5-50 lb (Pair)
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 to 50 lb per hand, expandable to 90 lb, Pin-selector weight system, Compact block-shaped design.
strengths: Expandable in stages to 90 lb per hand as strength increases
Narrowest footprint of the premium options, useful in a shared garage gym
Steel internals feel durable over years of daily use
limitations: Buying all expansion stages costs more in total than a single higher-ceiling set bought upfront
Smaller install base and parts ecosystem than Bowflex
features: 5 to 50 lb per hand, expandable to 90 lb

products.name: NordicTrack 55 lb Select-a-Weight Dumbbell
products.blurb: Key specs: Up to 55 lb per hand, 2.5, 5, and 10 lb increments, iFIT connected workout compatibility.
strengths: Highest fixed weight ceiling among the dial systems in this list
iFIT integration adds guided strength programming for a home gym setup
Fine low-end increments for gradual progression on accessory lifts
limitations: Full iFIT benefits require a paid subscription
Hardened plastic shell shows cosmetic wear sooner than steel-block designs

products.name: Core Home Fitness Adjustable Dumbbell Set & Stand
products.blurb: Key specs: 5 to 50 lb per hand, TwistLock one-hand cradle adjustment, Stand included.
strengths: Lowest price among cradle and dial systems in this list
Simple twist motion with a short learning curve
limitations: 50 lb ceiling is the lowest of the four picks here
Smaller install base and shorter track record than Bowflex or PowerBlock

howWeChose: Picks are based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. We don't claim our own testing.
We do not list prices or star ratings because they change. Check Amazon for current details.
